About our shelter

Dog & cat shelter

Trusted dog and cat shelter in Monroe County, Michigan. We care for dogs and cats until they find forever homes — playful kittens, loyal dogs, and everyone in between get the individualized attention they need to thrive.

🐾 Warm, loving care every day
How we care Our story Day in the life Get involved

How we care for animals

Every pet receives low-stress handling, daily exercise, group play, and temperature-controlled comfort.

🌿

Fear Free & The Please Program

Our entire team is trained and certified in the Fear Free program. We also incorporate The Please Program so animals learn to settle calmly before leaving their kennel.

🐕

Playgroups, walks & leash manners

Dogs benefit immensely from group playtime. We match dogs in supervised groups of two to five, and help them master leash manners with all four paws on the ground.

🚗

Doggy Day Out & foster sleepovers

Volunteers take shelter dogs out for park strolls, lake visits, and pup cups. Staff often take pets home overnight to relieve kennel stress and assess household fit.

❄️

Climate-controlled comfort

Our facility features dedicated air conditioning and heating throughout all dog kennels, cat rooms, and cuddle offices so every animal stays safe and relaxed.

Our Legacy

A safe haven since 1954

For more than seventy years the Humane Society of Monroe County has rehabilitated and rehomed dogs, puppies, cats, and kittens while promoting responsible pet ownership. Our mission is to provide a safe haven with the love and daily care every homeless pet deserves until they find a forever home.

A day in the life at our shelter

A peek inside our daily routines, enrichment programs, and volunteer outings.

Supervised playgroups

Dogs play in matched groups of two to five with staff and volunteers watching every interaction.

Doggy Day Out

Volunteers take dogs to parks, lakes, and calm outings that build confidence away from the kennel.

Comfortable kennels

Air conditioning in dog kennels and the cat room keeps everyone cool and resting well.

Get involved

Adoption, volunteering, and giving power everything we do. Volunteers lead playgroups, Doggy Day Out outings, and daily enrichment. When you are ready to adopt, apply, donate, or ask a question, connect with our team!
